## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

[ Orthopaedics ][174]

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

3. Medtronic AI Compass
4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

### Research innovation

Advancing patient care through innovative orthopedic research and development.

[Find out more][150]

### Clinical evidence

Delivering high impact clinical studies for better clinical care.

[Find out more][151]

### Innovation Translation

The AO's innovation powerhouse, bringing together diverse market-leading activities to better meet
current clinical needs.

[Find out more][152]

### Education

Dedicated to improving performance through outstanding educational offerings.

[Find out more][153]
[Read more][154]

## Our community

The AO is a network of over half a million health-care professionals in over 160 countries. 

[Discover AO Trauma][155]
[Discover AO Spine][156]
[Discover AO CMF][157]
[Discover AO VET][158]
[Discover AO Recon][159]
[Discover AO Sports][160]
[Find out more][161]

## Our services and resources

### AO Surgery Reference

Surgical decision made easy with literature evaluated and prepared for quick reference.

[Learn more][162]

### AO Approved Solutions

Offering detailed descriptions of AO Technical Commission Approved Solutions, including videos and
cases.

[AO Approved Solutions][163]

### Online learning

The AO is constantly looking for new ways to reach its audience, improve patient outcomes, and
enhance value for its community.

[Explore e-learning][164]

### Publications

The AO produces a diverse range of medical books, journals, and course materials/presentations.

[Explore our publications][165]
[Find out more][166]

## Our courses and events

Since the AO was founded, approximately 1.1 million surgeons and operating room personnel have
participated in AO courses in over 160 countries.

[ [AO Davos Courses visual promo] ][167]

### Build your AO Davos Courses experience! 

Join us in Davos from November 29–December 11, 2026 for the AO's flagship educational event.

[Register now][168]

### AO educational events

Each year the AO offers approximately 900 educational events around the world, supported by over
8,000 faculty, and attended by over 65,000 participants.

[Find out more][169]

### Global Spine Congress

The Global Spine Congress (GSC) is one of the biggest gatherings for thousands of spine surgeons
from all over the world.

[Find out more][170]

### Course finder

Use the course finder tool to see what's on the agenda for upcoming educational events in your
field.

[Use course finder][171]
[Use course finder][172]

### Stay in touch

Connect with us and join our AO community or subscribe to receive the latest AO news, calls, and
updates.

[Subscribe][173]

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

### Research innovation

Advancing patient care through innovative orthopedic research and development.

[Find out more][150]

### Clinical evidence

Delivering high impact clinical studies for better clinical care.

[Find out more][151]

### Innovation Translation

The AO's innovation powerhouse, bringing together diverse market-leading activities to better meet
current clinical needs.

[Find out more][152]

### Education

Dedicated to improving performance through outstanding educational offerings.

[Find out more][153]
[Read more][154]

## Our community

The AO is a network of over half a million health-care professionals in over 160 countries. 

[Discover AO Trauma][155]
[Discover AO Spine][156]
[Discover AO CMF][157]
[Discover AO VET][158]
[Discover AO Recon][159]
[Discover AO Sports][160]
[Find out more][161]

## Our services and resources

### AO Surgery Reference

Surgical decision made easy with literature evaluated and prepared for quick reference.

[Learn more][162]

### AO Approved Solutions

Offering detailed descriptions of AO Technical Commission Approved Solutions, including videos and
cases.

[AO Approved Solutions][163]

### Online learning

The AO is constantly looking for new ways to reach its audience, improve patient outcomes, and
enhance value for its community.

[Explore e-learning][164]

### Publications

The AO produces a diverse range of medical books, journals, and course materials/presentations.

[Explore our publications][165]
[Find out more][166]

## Our courses and events

Since the AO was founded, approximately 1.1 million surgeons and operating room personnel have
participated in AO courses in over 160 countries.

[ [AO Davos Courses visual promo] ][167]

### Build your AO Davos Courses experience! 

Join us in Davos from November 29–December 11, 2026 for the AO's flagship educational event.

[Register now][168]

### AO educational events

Each year the AO offers approximately 900 educational events around the world, supported by over
8,000 faculty, and attended by over 65,000 participants.

[Find out more][169]

### Global Spine Congress

The Global Spine Congress (GSC) is one of the biggest gatherings for thousands of spine surgeons
from all over the world.

[Find out more][170]

### Course finder

Use the course finder tool to see what's on the agenda for upcoming educational events in your
field.

[Use course finder][171]
[Use course finder][172]

### Stay in touch

Connect with us and join our AO community or subscribe to receive the latest AO news, calls, and
updates.

[Subscribe][173]

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

## Colorado Spine Partners

Colorado Spine Partners is a group practice composed of four fellowship-trained orthopedic spine
surgeons. Our philosophy emphasizes exhausting non-surgical treatment options before considering
spine surgery. When surgery is necessary, they utilize the latest technological advances in
minimally invasive spine.

#### Non-surgical Treatments

Our physicians emphasize a non-surgical approach before considering spine surgery.

#### Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery

Learn about spine procedures such as ALIF, LIF, PLIF, TLIF that Dr. Wong, Dr. Jatana and Dr.
Ghiselli perform.

#### Lumbar Microsurgery

Dr. David Wong is a fellowship-trained board-certified orthopedic spine surgeon with a specialty in
lumbar microsurgery

# Artificial Disc Replacement

For patients with cervical disc herniation or degeneration, Dr. Jatana offers Mobi-C® artificial
disc replacement as an option to preserve motion in the neck compared to traditional cervical
fusion.

The advantages of the Mobi-C® device over traditional cervical fusion is that the artificial disc
maintains normal motion and reduces the stress placed on the other discs in the neck. The goal with
motion preservation is to retain the normal rotation of the neck and lessen the need for any future
surgery at other levels in the neck.

[Learn More][36]

# Conservative Treatment Options

The spine physicians at Colorado Spine Partners share the same philosophy in that they emphasize
nonsurgical treatment options in advance of spine surgery. Non-surgical treatment options are now
provided through pain management specialists and spine therapists.
[Learn More][37]

## Our Physicians

Colorado Spine Partners is a group practice composed of three board-certified, fellowship-trained
orthopedic spine surgeons.

### Gary Ghiselli, MD

[View Bio][41]

### Spine Center Network

Colorado Spine Partners is the only spine center in the State of Colorado to be included in Spine
Center Network, the only national listing of credentialed spine centers. To be included, a spine
center must meet credentialing criteria that relates to having a multi-disciplinary team of
affiliated nonsurgical spine MDs, fellowship-trained spine specialized surgeons and spine
therapists. The spine team emphasizes nonsurgical treatment options; minimally invasive spine
surgery; motion preservation surgery via artificial disc replacement, patient education; and home
remedies for back and neck pain.

[Learn More][42]

### Centers for Artificial Disc

Colorado Spine Partners and Dr. Sanjay Jatana are featured by [CentersforArtificialDisc.com][43], a
national listing of spine surgeons who specialize in artificial disc replacement and are trained in
the use of the most current FDA-approved artificial discs for motion preservation that reduce the
risk of future herniations caused by fusion.

## Не дистриб'ютор коробок, а партнер з оснащення

20+ років профіль — оснащення медичних установ. Сильна сторона не в наявності складу, а в розумінні,
що саме потрібно під конкретну операцію.

◑

### Підбір під операцію

Знаємо хірургічні протоколи — від АКШ і клапанів до судинних і мікровтручань. Комплектуємо під
методику, а не «що є на складі».

✓

### Офіційне представництво

Працюємо напряму з виробниками. Оригінальна продукція, гарантія та технічна підтримка від бренду.

▤

### Реєстрація та документи

Реєстрація МОЗ України, повний пакет дозвільних і супровідних документів для тендерів і закупівель.

⤳

### Логістика та супровід

Постачання клінікам по всій Україні, консультація на етапі вибору й супровід після постачання.

документи та постачання.

Як ми працюємо

Опишіть напрямок, операцію або конкретну модель. Телефоном, поштою чи через форму.

### Підбір

Підбираємо бренд, модель і комплектацію під методику та бюджет, надаємо специфікацію.

### Документи

Готуємо комерційну пропозицію, реєстраційні та супровідні документи для закупівлі.

### Постачання

Доставляємо, вводимо в експлуатацію за потреби та супроводжуємо після.

Committed to improving the care and well-being of orthopedic and spine patients Through close
collaboration with expert surgeons globally, continuous investments in R&D, and the adoption of
cutting-edge technologies, our innovation prioritizes minimally invasive surgery and personalized
solutions for every patient, maintaining a strong focus on healthcare sustainability. [Discover
more][248]
A unique history: founded by an orthopedic patient Medacta was founded in 1999 by Dr. Alberto
Siccardi, an orthopedic patient whose personal experience inspired a mission to pioneer innovative
solutions that enhance patient outcomes in joint replacement, sports medicine, and spine surgery.
[Discover more][249]
More than 20 Years of Proven Success Advancing MIS Hip Replacement. Continuous innovation in
optimized implants, advanced materials, minimally invasive techniques, and tailored education.
[Discover more][250]
More than 10 years of success of Kinematic Alignment with Ball-In-Socket design Over the past ten
years, the synergy between the Kinematic Alignment (KA) technique and our Ball-in-Socket (B-i-S)
design has demonstrated progress in improving patient satisfaction in TKR. Medacta has been a
pioneer in Kinematic Alignment (KA), leading the way in research, development, and education.
[Discover more][251]
Personalized Sports Medicine Solutions Our **portfolio **leverages in-depth anatomical analysis to
**design personalized repair** and **reconstructive solutions**. This approach aims to enhance
**natural joint motion** and **improve patients’ satisfaction** with clinically superior outcomes.
[Discover more][252]
With the M.O.R.E. Institute the surgeon is never alone Our global medical education platform
provides surgeons with personalized and structured education programs. It relies on an international
network of expert surgeons to create interactive networking opportunities and a variety of
educational events, facilitating the learning and sharing of experiences. [Discover more][253]
#beMedacta Culture: a key for sustainable success We always strive to strengthen our #beMedacta
culture, which is key to sustainable success and actively contributes to our growth. We want to
ensure that our people understand and live our culture and values. We believe it is of the utmost
importance that our values are kept alive. [Discover more][254]

Committed to improving the care and well-being of orthopedic and spine patients Through close
collaboration with expert surgeons globally, continuous investments in R&D, and the adoption of
cutting-edge technologies, our innovation prioritizes minimally invasive surgery and personalized
solutions for every patient, maintaining a strong focus on healthcare sustainability. [Discover
more][248]
A unique history: founded by an orthopedic patient Medacta was founded in 1999 by Dr. Alberto
Siccardi, an orthopedic patient whose personal experience inspired a mission to pioneer innovative
solutions that enhance patient outcomes in joint replacement, sports medicine, and spine surgery.
[Discover more][249]
More than 20 Years of Proven Success Advancing MIS Hip Replacement. Continuous innovation in
optimized implants, advanced materials, minimally invasive techniques, and tailored education.
[Discover more][250]
More than 10 years of success of Kinematic Alignment with Ball-In-Socket design Over the past ten
years, the synergy between the Kinematic Alignment (KA) technique and our Ball-in-Socket (B-i-S)
design has demonstrated progress in improving patient satisfaction in TKR. Medacta has been a
pioneer in Kinematic Alignment (KA), leading the way in research, development, and education.
[Discover more][251]
Personalized Sports Medicine Solutions Our **portfolio **leverages in-depth anatomical analysis to
**design personalized repair** and **reconstructive solutions**. This approach aims to enhance
**natural joint motion** and **improve patients’ satisfaction** with clinically superior outcomes.
[Discover more][252]
With the M.O.R.E. Institute the surgeon is never alone Our global medical education platform
provides surgeons with personalized and structured education programs. It relies on an international
network of expert surgeons to create interactive networking opportunities and a variety of
educational events, facilitating the learning and sharing of experiences. [Discover more][253]
#beMedacta Culture: a key for sustainable success We always strive to strengthen our #beMedacta
culture, which is key to sustainable success and actively contributes to our growth. We want to
ensure that our people understand and live our culture and values. We believe it is of the utmost
importance that our values are kept alive. [Discover more][254]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

Order official merchandise with the Mount Bonnell logo. T-shirts, mugs, sweaters & more! We have it

parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

### About Practice

OBGYN CARE is a premier women’s health practice caring for patients in two locations in Newport
Beach and Irvine, California. Catalin Marinescu, MD, FACOG, offers expert care for women’s health,
including obstetrics and gynecology, along with infertility. 

Dr. Marinescu is highly proficient in minimally invasive surgery with the da VinciⓇ robotic system
and has earned the practice a Center of Excellence Designation. He prides himself on having no
complications whatsoever during any of his procedures, giving peace of mind to patients.

The team at OBGYN CARE caters to women of all cultural backgrounds and ages at every stage of their
health journeys. They provide a variety of services, including pregnancy care and gynecological care
for issues such as endometriosis, pelvic pain, and ovarian cysts. Patients also seek help for
urogynecological issues such as urinary incontinence, interstitial cystitis, and bladder pain.

At OBGYN CARE, every aspect of women’s health care is exceptional, inclusive, and compassionate with
the goal of exceeding patient expectations and giving them the best possible outcomes. To learn more
or make an appointment, call one of the offices or use the online booking tool on this website.

##### Why Fibroids Can Cause Heavy Bleeding

By age 50, 70–80% of women will develop fibroids, although many remain asymptomatic. When symptoms

helps women recognize when their symptoms are not normal.

types. They may cause miscarriage, preterm birth, and complications, but treatment can improve
outcomes.

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

aprevo^{®} utilizes advanced algorithms and state-of-the-art 3D modeling to develop personalized
surgical plans and spinal implants, all with one goal in mind: empowering you to Get Your Power
Back™.

In collaboration with your surgeon, we leverage your spinal imaging and our AI-enabled technology to
create a personalized alignment plan tailored exclusively to you. aprevo^{®} implants, manufactured
through advanced 3D printing technology, are then meticulously designed and delivered for your
aprevo^{®} procedure.

Talk to your doctor about aprevo^{®} patient-specific spinal implants, or find a doctor with our
surgeon locator. Enter your zip code to find an aprevo^{®} Personalized Spine Provider near you.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

[ Pricing Options ][63]

Fast and efficient robot welding

[ Welding application ][64]

Advanced machining with high accuracy

[ Machining application ][65]

Reliable dispensing with customizable control

[ Dispensing application ][66]

Polishing

[ Polishing application ][67]

Cutting

Precise cutting with accurate programming

[ Cutting application ][68]

Palletizing

Robotic palletizing made simple

[ Palletizing application ][69]

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

# Positive patient outcomes start with promptly delivered high-quality surgical supplies.

Are you looking for the latest innovations in surgical devices? Do you need top-notch technology and
reliable medical supplies with fast delivery?
**We have the right solution for you.**

**SLR Medical Consulting** provides the highest quality surgical products and solutions to a network
of surgeons and doctors across the country, with a track record that reflects quality and
trustworthiness.

[LEARN MORE][29]

## Our Featured Products and Solutions

We are committed to excellence and punctuality, delivering superior medical devices with
zero-lead-time processing. Improve patient care and operational resources for your healthcare
practice with SLR.

**A History of Excellence**

For over a decade, SLR Medical Consulting has been supplying thousands of medical facilities across
the country with the latest surgical technology, instruments, and implants to make repairs and
surgical interventions ranging from craniotomies to total toes, and everything in between. We’re
proud to provide communities and businesses around the US with the supplies they need to improve
their practices and stay safe.

## SPORTS MEDICINE

Helping athletes get back in the game, we offer surgical hardware specific to sports medicine
applications.

[LEARN MORE][30]

## SURGICAL HARDWARE

Explore top-quality surgical hardware across a wide variety of surgical applications.

[LEARN MORE][31]

## SURGICAL DIVISION

SLR Medical Consulting is a medical and surgical supply company with an exemplary reputation for
quality...

[LEARN MORE][32]

## DISTRIBUTOR OPPORTUNITIES

We work with only top-quality manufacturers to provide medical supplies across the US...

[LEARN MORE][33]

## 28+

Distributor Opportunities

## Why Choose SLR?

We understand that you have options, but at **SLR Medical Consulting**, we are dedicated to
providing excellent products to improve patient care and healthcare practices in record time. With
our own fully-stocked warehouses, we are ready to deliver high-quality surgical supplies, devices,
and instrumentation to your practice, anywhere in the country.

Whether you’re a medical facility, a local employer, or a community member, we can equip you with
state-of-the-art medical and surgical supplies to improve patient outcome and to keep you and those
around you safe.

[LEARN MORE][34]

## Delivering Safety & Quality

### Schedule a discovery call

Explore our latest surgical devices, instrumentation, and biologic supplies. Tell us what you need
and discover what SLR can bring to your business.

### Get a proposal

We’ll provide you with a complete proposal, with our agreement and deliverability terms.

### Improve your medical practice with cutting-edge surgical products

# Positive patient outcomes start with promptly delivered high-quality surgical supplies.

Are you looking for the latest innovations in surgical devices? Do you need top-notch technology and
reliable medical supplies with fast delivery?
**We have the right solution for you.**

**SLR Medical Consulting** provides the highest quality surgical products and solutions to a network

trustworthiness.

## Our Featured Products and Solutions

zero-lead-time processing. Improve patient care and operational resources for your healthcare

the country with the latest surgical technology, instruments, and implants to make repairs and
surgical interventions ranging from craniotomies to total toes, and everything in between. We’re
proud to provide communities and businesses around the US with the supplies they need to improve

For over two decades, Spinal Elements has innovated differentiated spine technologies that enable
fundamental shifts in solutions for spine surgery. Our advanced, patient-centric medical devices and
biologics are changing the way surgeons solve spine surgery challenges.

## A DIFFERENTIATED APPROACH TO SPINE SURGERY

At Spinal Elements, we are inspired by our surgeon partners, healthcare providers and their patients
to innovate and engineer novel and proprietary spine surgery technologies that make a clinical
difference in improving the quality of life for spine surgery patients.

 

We encourage a culture based on community, commitment, creativity and curiosity by collaborating
with surgeons, experts and researchers to transform spine surgery to advance patient care in
minimally invasive spine surgery.

 

Spinal Elements has been delivering innovative, proprietary technologies since our inception in
2004. We continue to be a market leader in commercializing spine surgery solutions by leveraging our
proprietary technologies, valuable distributor relationship and strategic leadership team.

 

We look forward to continue to serve the healthcare community in the many years to come.

# Inspiring Surgeons and Patients to Think Differently

For over two decades, Spinal Elements has innovated differentiated spine technologies that enable
fundamental shifts in solutions for spine surgery. Our advanced, patient-centric medical devices and
biologics are changing the way surgeons solve spine surgery challenges.

## A DIFFERENTIATED APPROACH TO SPINE SURGERY

At Spinal Elements, we are inspired by our surgeon partners, healthcare providers and their patients
to innovate and engineer novel and proprietary spine surgery technologies that make a clinical
difference in improving the quality of life for spine surgery patients.

 

We encourage a culture based on community, commitment, creativity and curiosity by collaborating
with surgeons, experts and researchers to transform spine surgery to advance patient care in
minimally invasive spine surgery.

 

Spinal Elements has been delivering innovative, proprietary technologies since our inception in
2004. We continue to be a market leader in commercializing spine surgery solutions by leveraging our
proprietary technologies, valuable distributor relationship and strategic leadership team.

 

We look forward to continue to serve the healthcare community in the many years to come.

[Learn More][108]

## 
## Our Focus

Spinal Elements delivers value by focusing on the fastest growing segments of the spine market
through a portfolio proprietary technologies including inventive interbody solutions, non-metal
fixation devices and adjacent technologies that address surgical needs in growing patient
populations with minimally-invasive procedures performed in hospitals and ambulatory surgery
centers.

## **Procedural Solutions**

Revolutionizing the standard of care in posterior fixation, our metal-free, solution minimizes
surgical disruption to facilitate facet fusion and spinal stability.

Our patients-first philosophy drives our continual innovation to deliver spine surgery solutions
that cover most major spinal procedures.

## Spineway designs innovative technologies for spinal surgery

][38]

Spineway is an independent French company, founded in Lyon in 2005, specializing in the design and
development of innovative technologies for spine surgery. By combining French expertise with an
international network, we have seized major growth opportunities with the acquisitions of Distimp in
2021 and Spine Innovations in 2022. These integrations have enable us to broaden our offering by
combining complementary product portfolios and territories, while proposing innovative solutions to
treat new pathologies. Much more than just a manufacturer, we are committed to our surgeon partners.
We offer a global program of customized training courses in surgical techniques, tailored to meet
the specific needs of practitioners.

][38]

development of innovative technologies for spine surgery. By combining French expertise with an
international network, we have seized major growth opportunities with the acquisitions of Distimp in
2021 and Spine Innovations in 2022. These integrations have enable us to broaden our offering by
combining complementary product portfolios and territories, while proposing innovative solutions to
treat new pathologies. Much more than just a manufacturer, we are committed to our surgeon partners.
We offer a global program of customized training courses in surgical techniques, tailored to meet
the specific needs of practitioners.

## FAQ

### What is rhinoplasty surgery?

Rhinoplasty is a surgical procedure to reshape or repair the nose for cosmetic reasons or to improve
nasal function (e.g., breathing). It may involve altering the bone, cartilage, or skin of the nose.

### What are the main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty?

The main types of instruments used in rhinoplasty include:
* **Scalpels** (for making precise incisions),
* **Rongeurs** (for removing bone or cartilage),
* **Osteotomes** (for shaping bones),
* **Elevators** (for lifting tissues),
* **Forceps** (for grasping tissues),
* **Rasp** (for smoothing the nasal bone),
* **Cautery devices** (to stop bleeding),
* **Sutures** (for closing incisions).

### Why are osteotomes used in rhinoplasty?

Osteotomes are chisel-like instruments used to cut, reshape, or remove bone during rhinoplasty. They
are particularly useful when adjusting the shape of the nasal bones, such as narrowing the nose or
realigning the bones after a break.

### What is the purpose of nasal splints in rhinoplasty?

Nasal splints are applied after surgery to provide support and protect the nose during healing. They
help maintain the newly reshaped structure and reduce swelling while promoting proper healing.

### How are sutures used in rhinoplasty?

Sutures are used to close the incisions made during surgery. They can be either dissolvable
(absorbed by the body over time) or non-dissolvable (requiring removal after a few days). They
ensure the wound stays closed while healing occurs.

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

Forceps are used to grasp or hold tissues, cartilage, or other structures during the surgery. Their
precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

A scalpel is essential for making precise, clean incisions that allow the surgeon to access the
nasal bones, cartilage, and skin without unnecessary trauma to the surrounding tissues. It ensures
minimal scarring.

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

A rasp is a tool used to smooth and shape the nasal bones after they have been cut or reshaped. It
works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,

### What is the role of forceps in rhinoplasty?

precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

A scalpel is essential for making precise, clean incisions that allow the surgeon to access the
nasal bones, cartilage, and skin without unnecessary trauma to the surrounding tissues. It ensures
minimal scarring.

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

A rasp is a tool used to smooth and shape the nasal bones after they have been cut or reshaped. It
works like a file, gently filing down rough edges and contouring the bone to achieve a smoother,
more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

### What is a cautery device used for in rhinoplasty?

A cautery device is used to stop bleeding during surgery by sealing blood vessels. This minimizes
blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

### How does a speculum aid in rhinoplasty surgery?

A nasal speculum is an instrument used to widen the nostrils, allowing the surgeon to have a better
view and access to the nasal cavity during surgery. It helps in visualizing internal nasal
structures for precise adjustments.

### What is the function of a surgical rongeur in rhinoplasty?

A rongeur is used for removing or trimming bone or cartilage. It has sharp, curved jaws that help
with cutting and shaping structures, especially when reducing or sculpting the nasal bones during
the procedure.

### Are there any special instruments for cartilage grafting in rhinoplasty?

Yes, special instruments are used for cartilage grafting. These tools help shape and implant
cartilage from other areas (e.g., the septum, ear, or rib) to provide structural support or enhance
the nasal appearance. They are used to carefully harvest and place the grafts.

### How long does it take to complete a rhinoplasty procedure?

The length of a rhinoplasty surgery can vary depending on the complexity of the procedure. On
average, it takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, though it may take longer if additional procedures, such as
cartilage grafting or septoplasty, are involved.

### Why is surgical suction necessary during rhinoplasty?

Surgical suction is used to remove blood, fluids, or debris from the surgical area. This ensures the
surgeon has a clear view of the nasal structures, which is crucial for precise and safe surgery.

### What kind of aftercare is required after rhinoplasty?

After rhinoplasty, patients typically need to rest and avoid any strenuous activities for several
weeks. Nasal packing or splints may be used temporarily, and follow-up appointments are important to
monitor healing. Swelling and bruising are common, and pain management is part of post-operative
care.

### Are there risks involved with using surgical instruments in rhinoplasty?

As with any surgery, there are potential risks, including infection, scarring, excessive bleeding,
or damage to the nasal structures. However, skilled surgeons use these instruments with great care,
and complications are rare when proper procedures are followed.

### Do all surgeons use the same instruments for rhinoplasty?

Most surgeons use a similar set of instruments, but there may be slight variations depending on the
surgeon’s preferences, the type of rhinoplasty (open vs. closed), and the complexity of the
procedure. Some surgeons may also use advanced technology like endoscopes in specific cases.

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.

* Pay your bill

# Expanding the Family!

The pana*SI*a SI Fusion System represents a strategic expansion of Wenzel Spine’s portfolio of
stand-alone expandable devices. Backed by over 17 years of expertise in expandable implant design
and manufacturing, pana*SI*a delivers a unique solution for a historically underserved patient
population.

[Learn More about panaSIa][81]
[Contact Us][82]
[varilift-lx-home-header-1-2]

# Less Hardware.

Our mission is to improve patient quality of life by providing innovative and proven spine
technologies. We strive to make a positive impact in healthcare by providing superior, high quality
products that simplify spine surgery and reduce cost. 

[The VariLift®-LX SLIF Procedure][83]

## Simple, Strong, Screw-less

The Wenzel Spine's Standalone Fusion Solutions offer surgeons a simple surgical approach for
patients who may benefit from sacroiliac, lumbar or cervical fusion, *without the need for
supplemental fixation*. When it comes to spine treatment, often a "less is more" approach is a
better alternative for patients prioritizing less hardware, anatomy preservation, and spinal
longevity.

TOUCH
The panaSIa SI Procedure

# Less Hardware.

Our mission is to improve patient quality of life by providing innovative and proven spine
technologies. We strive to make a positive impact in healthcare by providing superior, high quality
products that simplify spine surgery and reduce cost. 

[The VariLift®-LX SLIF Procedure][83]

## Simple, Strong, Screw-less

The Wenzel Spine's Standalone Fusion Solutions offer surgeons a simple surgical approach for
patients who may benefit from sacroiliac, lumbar or cervical fusion, *without the need for
supplemental fixation*. When it comes to spine treatment, often a "less is more" approach is a
better alternative for patients prioritizing less hardware, anatomy preservation, and spinal
longevity.
